newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis International Bank raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunis International Bank raises capital.

text.p: Privately owned offshore bank Tunis International Bank (TIB) said on Friday it had raised its capital to $25 million from $20 million.
"The increase by five million dollars had been fully subscribed and liberated by shareholders," the Tunis-based bank said in a statement.
TIB raised its capital in 1995 to $20 million from $15 million.
It reported a $625,000 net profit during the first half of 1996, up from $506,552 during the same period in 1995.
The Tunis-based bank, the first off-shore bank to be established in Tunisia in 1982, includes Middle East banking and financial institutions and Tunisian private investors among its shareholders.
